words.meaning: About; not exactly, but close to.
words.example: The journey takes approximately two hours.
words.example_fa: سفر تقریباً دو ساعت طول می‌کشد.

words.example: He is an average student, not the best.

words.example_fa: من در ایستگاه اتوبوس منتظر اتوبوس می‌مانم.

words.meaning: The front part of your body between your neck and stomach.
words.example: He felt a pain in his chest.
words.example_fa: او دردی در سینه‌اش احساس کرد.

words.meaning: Pleasant or beautiful to look at.
words.example: She has a very attractive smile.

words.meaning: The part of your face below your mouth.
words.example: He has a small scar on his chin.

words.meaning: Strong, healthy, and good at sports.

words.meaning: Very pleasing to the senses; lovely.
A ticket allowing you to get on a plane.
